description: This is a JavaScript module implementing a calculus engine with functions for derivatives, integrals, and limits, utilizing the mathjs library. It defines an exported main function 'calculate' that performs symbolic and numerical calculus computations based on user-specified options.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that performs calculus operations (derivative, integral, limit) based on provided options.

methods.name: toLatex
methods.description: Helper function to convert expressions to LaTeX format.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Converts string input to numerical value, handling pi and division signs.

methods.name: tryLimit
methods.description: Attempts to evaluate limits via direct substitution or L'Hospital's rule.

methods.name: splitFraction
methods.description: Splits an expression string into numerator and denominator if it's a fraction.

methods.name: tryIntegrate
methods.description: Attempts to compute the indefinite integral of an expression.
